text:
Create a NEW premium raster illustration, use-case stylized-concept, for a Sushi Dash game catalog CARD BACKGROUND. Output a wide landscape banner approximately 1792x640 (2.8:1). This is ART ONLY, no interface, no text, no logo, no words, no symbols resembling letters, no buttons, no border.
REFERENCES: image1 existing Sushi Dash loading illustration is a reference for the established Moti character identity, high quality soft 3D illustrated game art, Japanese wooden sushi shop, orange/teal palette; image2 in-game cats selection screenshot is a reference for actual Moti facial proportions and red collar, ignore all interface. Create new composition, do not copy the portrait layout or logo.
CONCEPT 1: INTIMATE MASCOT PORTRAIT. One unmistakable Moti orange tabby cat with broad slightly boxy head, pointed wide-set pink ears, enormous round amber eyes with cream rims, cream muzzle and paws, tiny pink nose, small CLOSED gentle smiling mouth, red collar and small gold bell. Moti holds one delicious salmon nigiri in both paws. Bust portrait with his face centered around x48%, y52%, big readable eyes; paws and nigiri in lower middle. Cropping chest at bottom is intentional. Softly blurred cozy wooden sushi counter behind him, teal noren and softly glowing red lantern near far right, warm afternoon rim light on orange fur against rich turquoise background. High polish, clean shapes, soft tactile fur, charming loyal recreation of the established mascot rather than generic kitten. Calm friendly mood, teal dominates, salmon orange accents.
CRITICAL CARD COMPOSITION: entire wide banner is full bleed with a coherent scene. It will be shown at 343x124 with a 70% black overlay and real UI ABOVE it. Keep upper-left quadrant low detail for title and status, upper-right quadrant low detail for play/trash buttons. Make the main face centered horizontally and mostly in middle/lower band with strong bright silhouette readable under dimming. Bright source art: DO NOT pre-darken, no black fade baked in. Keep both eyes and ears within frame. No extra cats, no hands, no UI, no branding.

Create a NEW premium raster illustration, use-case stylized-concept, for a Sushi Dash game catalog CARD BACKGROUND. Wide landscape banner approximately 1792x640 (2.8:1). ART ONLY: absolutely no text, logos, UI, buttons, borders, lettering or watermarks.
REFERENCES: image1 existing Sushi Dash loading illustration supplies established Moti character identity, soft high quality 3D game-art finish and Japanese wooden sushi-street setting. image2 actual gameplay screenshot supplies the three-lane road, teal delivery vehicles, collectible salmon nigiri, distant Fuji world; ignore all interface. Make a wholly new horizontal action composition.
CONCEPT 2: THE DASH, energetic story scene. The exact orange tabby Moti with broad slightly boxy cute head, HUGE amber eyes, cream muzzle/paws, red collar/gold bell, small closed mischievous smile is running/leaping diagonally toward the viewer, carrying a salmon nigiri. Moti is the crisp hero in the middle at x47%, feet/tail following toward the lower left. A smiling sushi chef in white chef clothes and dark teal headband/apron chases behind at x76%, smaller in perspective, reaching forward playfully. A single teal delivery van farther behind. Three-lane street sweeps into distance, wooden sushi storefronts and teal awnings, red lanterns, scattered pink sakura petals, blue sky and snow capped Mount Fuji on distant left background. Upbeat sunny color palette, sky blue/cyan/green with orange hero, cinematic motion in environment, sharp face. Not a gameplay screenshot: polished expressive key-art illustration retaining the real game identity.
CARD-SPECIFIC COMPOSITION: all story must fit a very shallow landscape crop. Hero face around center x47%, y55%, enough size to recognize at343x124. Upper-left and upper-right are simpler atmosphere so actual MS title and buttons can sit above. The face and salmon nigiri remain visible in central/lower strip. Avoid excessive tiny detail. Render bright source art with strong sunny highlights, since a 70% black dim layer will be applied externally. DO NOT add fade or dimming now. No visible interface or text on stores/lanterns.

Create a NEW premium raster illustration, use-case stylized-concept, for a Sushi Dash game catalog CARD BACKGROUND. Wide landscape approximately1792x640, ratio2.8:1. Full bleed ART ONLY, no title, no logo, no writing, no UI, no borders, no watermarks.
REFERENCES: image1 in-game cat selection screen defines the three existing game characters and costumes; ignore interface. image2 Sushi Dash loading art defines high-quality soft3D illustration style, warm Japanese sushi street and established Moti face. Do not replicate either layout.
CONCEPT 3: THE CAT CREW, cheerful ensemble with three EXISTING cats at a Japanese sushi counter. Centre foreground is the exact Moti orange tabby with broad slightly square cheeks, enormous amber eyes, cream muzzle/paws, red collar with golden bell, closed gentle smile. Left behind him is the existing white cat with a small red bow and mint/teal outfit; right behind him is the existing charcoal black/white cat in a teal hoodie with matching headphones. All have the same distinctive big-eyed game character style, not ordinary cats, no anthropomorphic hands. The three friends lean over a wooden counter displaying two small salmon nigiri and a maki, playful welcoming expressions. Frame as a wide ensemble portrait with Moti slightly larger. Creamy warm peach/coral afternoon setting, deep teal curtain corners, delicate out-of-focus sakura branch, warm soft lighting, bright orange/cream faces, clean storybook 3D forms. This concept should feel warmer and more social than the teal solo portrait or action chase, retaining recognizable Sushi Dash identity.
CARD COMPOSITION: key three faces span the middle60% of width and lower55% of height, Moti central x48%, y58%. Side cats slightly behind, fully readable eyes. Upper-left title zone and upper-right action button zone have calmer low-detail warm background. Make silhouettes big and readable at343x124 despite an external70% black dim overlay. Do NOT pre-darken or bake any fade. Avoid busy props, too many collectibles or oversized sushi obscuring faces. Absolutely no text anywhere.

prompt:
Edit this Sushi Dash chase banner to fix composition for a shallow app card with real controls. Preserve Moti's identity, 3D illustration quality, sushi street, small chef, van and Fuji world, bright sunny blue/orange/teal colors. Keep wide2.8:1 approximately2098x750.
Recompose all characters LOWER, and scale them down about25%. The top half should show sky, Fuji, distant upper shop roofs and soft background. The main cat runs toward the camera from the LOWER MIDDLE of frame; HARD GEOMETRY: Moti pupils at y=530px on750px canvas (70% down), face centered aroundx1000px (48% width). His head top can begin aroundy280px, muzzle aroundy660px; running torso and salmon nigiri can crop through bottom edge, with enough nigiri at lower right of face to suggest the chase. Both Moti eyes fully belowy440. Move small chef to right x=1580px, and his face must also be down aty540px, smaller, peeking/reaching around the cat, body cropped by bottom. Keep chase readable with perspective street, scattered petals and motion at edges. IMPORTANT: upper-left x0..950 y0..440 and upper-right x1050..2098 y0..440 will be occluded by real UI so no character faces there. Render only artwork, no UI, no frames, no words, no logos, no fake text, no dark overlay. Changed composition must have characters in LOWER HALF rather than dominant centered image. Preserve tiny CLOSED cat smile and exact Moti large amber eyes.

Edit the supplied ORIGINAL Sushi Dash banner with ONE strict geometric change and an outpaint. The user prefers this original composition over a redesigned one. Preserve the original image's exact illustration, characters, scale, proportions, height positions, colors, perspective and camera. Output the same wide2.8:1 landscape about2098x749.
TRANSLATE THE ENTIRE EXISTING IMAGE HORIZONTALLY LEFT BY280 PIXELS (13.35% of canvas width), which is approximately half the width of Moti's face. The leftmost280px naturally crop away. Do NOT scale down, zoom, redraw the original characters, change poses, move anything vertically, add sky at top, or change framing height. Moti's large running body and large head remain exactly their ORIGINAL SIZE and ORIGINAL VERTICAL POSITION. Chef, van, Fuji, road and storefronts all shift LEFT by the same280px, maintaining their relative positions.
Then OUTPAINT ONLY the newly exposed280px strip along the RIGHT edge. Seamlessly extend the existing Japanese sushi storefronts, wooden facades, teal awnings, red lanterns, roadside foliage and road perspective into that strip, matching original lighting and bright soft3D quality. Do not introduce any new character, vehicle or major foreground object in that new strip.
This is a straightforward left slide + right edge continuation of the original illustration. Do NOT recenter the cat, shrink him, move faces down or replace the scene. Keep existing cat closed smile and original amber eyes. No text, no logos, no interface, no overlays, no fade, no borders. All recognizable original details should be as unchanged as possible except horizontal translation.
